Gameplay-linked entity

This item is linked to gameplay, quests, services, collision, or shared-world state. Moving it is allowed. Deleting or duplicating it requires confirmation and may need a later server-catalog rebuild.

Free camera

WASD moves smoothly · Shift + WASD moves faster · Arrow keys rotate/tilt · left-drag in Camera mode orbits · mouse wheel zooms · Q/E zoom.

Movement keys continue working after you select an editor control. Drag with the middle or right mouse button to pan. Tool shortcuts are 1–7. Player View switches to the player camera.

Game UI is hidden by default. Use UI Edit when you want the playable HUD visible.

Terrain: choose Terrain, then drag on overworld ground to sculpt or paint; Save World publishes changes to players.

Asset placement: open Assets, choose a model, then click the terrain. Placement stays active for repeated placement; Cancel placement or switch tools to stop.
